title: General Construction in Steel - Code of Practice (Third Revision)

clauses.title: Partial Safety Factor for Materials (Table 5)
clauses.content: Partial safety factor for materials gamma_m: Resistance governed by yielding gamma_m0 = 1.10. Resistance governed by ultimate stress (buckling / rupture) gamma_m1 = 1.25. Resistance of connection: shop fabrication gamma_mf = 1.25, field fabrication gamma_mf = 1.50.

clauses.title: Maximum Slenderness Ratio (KL / r)
clauses.content: Maximum slenderness ratio lambda = KL / r: 1) A member carrying compressive loads resulting from dead loads and imposed loads = 180. 2) A member subjected to compression forces resulting from wind/earthquake loads = 250. 3) A member normally acting as a tie in a roof truss or a bracing system = 350. 4) Members always in tension = 400.

clauses.title: Design Compressive Strength (Pd)
clauses.content: The design compressive strength Pd of a member is given by: Pd = Ae * fcd, where Ae is effective sectional area and fcd is design compressive stress obtained from non-dimensional slenderness lambda and buckling curves a, b, c, d.

clauses.title: Design Bending Strength of Laterally Supported Beams (Md)
clauses.content: When laterally supported, the design bending strength Md is governed by plastic section modulus Zp: Md = beta_b * Zp * fy / gamma_m0 <= 1.2 * Ze * fy / gamma_m0 for simply supported beams, where beta_b = 1.0 for plastic/compact sections.

clauses.title: Design Shear Strength (Vd)
clauses.content: The design shear strength Vd of a web is given by: Vd = Vn / gamma_m0, where nominal shear capacity Vn = Vp = Av * fyw / sqrt(3). When design shear force V <= 0.6 Vd, there is no reduction in moment capacity.

clauses.title: Deflection Limits for Structural Steelwork
clauses.content: Limiting vertical deflection for simply supported beams: Under live load alone = Span / 300 (general building), Span / 360 (plastered ceiling). For cantilever beams = Span / 150. For crane gantry girders = Span / 500 to Span / 1000.
